OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_TIMEOUT.description: RST Cloud API request timeout, in seconds.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_UPDATE_CONFIDENCE.description: Whether to reduce the confidence of indicators flagged as noisy or benign.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_UPDATE_SCORE.description: Whether to reduce the score of indicators flagged as noisy or benign.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_CHANGE_ACTION_SCORE_CH.description: Amount by which the score (and confidence) is reduced when the action is 'Change Score'.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_DROP_ACTION_SCORE_CHAN.description: Amount by which the score (and confidence) is reduced when the action is 'Drop'.

RST_NOISE_CONTROL_DROP_ACTION_DETECTION_.description: Whether to unset the detection flag of indicators when the action is 'Drop'.
